notes: v3.6.0 — REAL-TIME + SELF-HEAL. (1) Real-time push: the agent holds an SSE stream (GET /print-jobs/stream) and prints the instant a ticket is enqueued (~sub-300ms) instead of waiting for a poll; the poll stays as a fallback (slow while streaming, fast when it drops). (2) Server hands jobs out via an atomic claim (PENDING->SENT lease, FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED) so a push+poll or a second agent / restart can't double-print. (3) Self-heal poll: any configured POLL_MS>1000 is clamped back to 800ms (POLL_ALLOW_SLOW=1 to opt out) so a stale 2-3s .env fixes itself on update. Set USE_STREAM=0 to force poll-only.
_status: ARMED 2026-09-05 — self-update is ON. Every agent on v3.3+ auto-updates to 3.6.0 within ~6h (download -> verify sha256 -> swap -> restart). The binary served by GET /api/print-agent/download is print-agent/dist/AtithiSetuPrintAgent.exe, force-committed so the VPS serves it. To pause self-update, set latest/sha256/url back to null. Server side (SSE endpoint + atomic claim, marker `print-realtime-sse-claim`) already deployed; the agent must be on 3.6.0 to USE the stream (older agents keep polling — still safe, claim de-dupes them). NOTE: prefer AGENT_EXE_PATH (VPS disk) or a CDN url for future releases to avoid committing the ~55MB binary to git history.
